reviews.text: They do a very good job, but they almost never answer the damn phone.

Always available when I stop by to have my dog's nails trimmed!
Thank you for this service! Not expensive at all!
Super kind and professional. My timid little dog never whined during any of their visits. And he gets a little treat before leaving. ❤️🤗 …
Thank you to Mother & Son for their excellent work…👌👏Noa😻 …
Never answers and doesn't take messages on the voicemail.
Great place! It's calm and welcoming! The staff are extremely attentive.
Thank you to the team at Toilettage Entre Chien et Chat for grooming my beloved pomeranian. He always comes back fresh and happy!

Thank you for grooming our beautiful Lily (Golden Retriever)!

I appreciated you asking me what kind of grooming I wanted and my preferences.

She got a lovely little trim, her coat is so soft, and she smells wonderful. 🩷
Friendly professional and competitive prices
Never again
Impeccable service, they were perfect with my very nervous dog during the nail trimming!
Professional and friendly. Muscade is super happy to get groomed there.
The owners are really nice and it's obvious that these people really love animals.
They took great care of my cat 10/10
The best grooming service for my beautiful dog Loupi. They are fantastic.

I'm giving it 4 stars because they don't accept cards. My dog ​​loves going to the groomer; he knows the way right away 😄. I read the comment and I honestly don't understand (I'm still keeping an eye on things, of course), but I've been taking Junior there for over a year now and nothing bad has happened (he's a Golden Retriever/Labrador mix). The staff are friendly, both the man and the woman, the price is very reasonable, and my dog ​​is big 😁. The cut is always exactly as requested. I don't know if we're just lucky, but based on my experience, I highly recommend them 💯 ☺️. He leaves smelling like a clean, fresh dog 🐶 😁.
Good service, great grooming, good price.

After more than 10 years at this place, the young man who works there has decided to set his own prices. Always ask the owner for the price, who, by the way, is very kind and professional. Unfortunately, as long as this young man is there, I've decided to avoid the place; I no longer trust him. Be wary and, above all, vigilant.
Professional service
Perfect lawn mowing and services!!!
Courteous staff, my dogs reacted well, and the staff did the job as I asked. I will definitely return.

I called to make an appointment, and a really rude man answered the phone. I told him I wanted to book my dog's first grooming appointment and that I'd like to know how to book one. He said, "Well, I don't understand what you want to know." He was completely unprofessional and didn't seem happy to be on the phone at all! I found a better place!
